from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The separator color is the color occurring most often in any single row.
    line_color = max(
        (v for row in grid for v in set(row)),
        key=lambda v: max(row.count(v) for row in grid)
    )

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(line_color) >= w - 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= h - 2]

    # Interior/background color is the most common non-separator color.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r1, r2 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row_out = []
        for c1, c2 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            color = corners[0]
            if color != line_color and color != background and all(v == color for v in corners):
                row_out.append(color)
            else:
                row_out.append(background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out

         for c in cols[1:]]
